snippet.title: Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu Championship 2017 (PS4) - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Game: Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu Championship 2017
Platform: PlayStation 4
Release Year: 2017

A full game of Pawapuro Championship 2017, released for PS4 but recorded here on PS5. This was a free-to-play online-focused version of Konami's cartoony baseball game series. The online services aren't available anymore, but you can still play exhibition games against the computer with NPB rosters from that time, so that's what I did here. 

***
You can also check out my website about baseball video games at https://30-30.club.
